composition: South side from Henric van Veldekeplein, westwork and Bergportaal · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From Henric van Veldekeplein the south wall of the Basilica of Saint Servatius runs between the heavy Romanesque westwork and the lighter Gothic aisle, with the sculpted Bergportaal in the south front. This is not the Vrijthof pairing with the red tower of Sint-Janskerk. The sky is clear, about 15.3°C, with wind near 10.4 km/h. Sunset was 19:26, so midnight is lamp light on the stone.
